prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: side impact at intersection. Injury: knee injury. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1104; do not mention it.)
text:
Dear Claims Representative:

This firm represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE] at a controlled intersection. Our client was proceeding through the intersection on a green signal when another vehicle entered from a crossing street and struck the driver's side of our client's car. The force of the impact drove the vehicle sideways and threw our client against the interior, where the left knee struck the dashboard structure.

Medical records document a torn meniscus and associated ligament strain. Our client attended physical therapy sessions and has been advised that further treatment, including a possible arthroscopic procedure, may be necessary. Our client has missed significant time from work and continues to experience swelling, limited range of motion, and difficulty with stairs and prolonged standing.

The police report confirms that the other driver admitted at the scene to failing to yield. Independent witness statements support our client's account of the signal phase.

Liability in this matter is clear. Our client's damages include past and future medical expenses, lost wages, and pain and suffering. Based on the documented injuries and treatment to date, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this incident. This offer remains open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.

Sincerely,

Counsel for [CLIENT_NAME]
